Act10-1#1.zh: 六月初四，杨志押送十一担生辰纲行至黄泥冈。山路险僻，他改趁早凉为日中赶路，又一路催打，军汉、虞候早已怨声满腹。
Act10-1#1.t: On the fourth of the sixth month, Yang Zhi escorted eleven loads of birthday gifts to Yellow Mud Ridge. The mountain road was steep and lonely. He had switched from travelling in the cool of morning to marching at midday, driving the men with the cane all the way, and the soldiers and guards were full of grumbling.

Act10-1#2.zh: 快走！赶过前面冈子去，却再理会。
Act10-1#2.t: Move it! Get over that ridge ahead, then we'll see.

Act10-1#3.zh: 这般火似热的天气，又挑着重担！不拣早凉行，动不动藤条打来，都是一般父母皮肉，我们直恁地苦！
Act10-1#3.t: Heat like fire, and these heavy loads on our backs! He won't travel in the cool of morning, and at every turn out comes the cane. Our skin's from parents too, same as anyone's. Why must we suffer so!

Act10-1#4.zh: 趁早不走，日里热时走不得，却又打我们！
Act10-1#4.t: He won't set out early, then when it's too hot to walk he beats us!

Act10-1#5.zh: 前日行的须是好地面，如今正是尴尬去处。若不日里赶过去，谁敢五更半夜走！
Act10-1#5.t: The roads before were safe country. This is a dangerous stretch. If we don't cross it by daylight, who'd dare walk it in the dead of night!

Act10-1#6.zh: 我们挑着百十斤担子，须不比他空手走的。前面有松阴，便歇一歇罢！
Act10-1#6.t: We're carrying loads of a hundred catties, not walking empty-handed like him. There's pine shade ahead; let's rest a bit!

Act10-1#7.zh: 你便剁做我七八段，其实去不得了！
Act10-1#7.t: Chop me into seven or eight pieces if you like, I really can't go on!

Act10-1#8.zh: 权且歇一歇，略过日中再行罢。
Act10-1#8.t: Let's rest a little and move on once the midday heat has passed.

Act10-1#9.zh: 这里正是强人出没的去处，地名叫做黄泥冈！白日里兀自出来劫人，谁敢在这里停脚！
Act10-1#9.t: This is exactly where bandits lurk. The place is called Yellow Mud Ridge! They rob people here in broad daylight. Who dares stop here!

Act10-1#10.zh: 你端的不把人当人！便是留守相公自来监押时，也容我们说一句！
Act10-1#10.t: You really don't treat people as people! Even when the Regent himself oversaw us, he'd let us say a word!

Act10-1#11.zh: 我见你说好几遍了，只管把这话来惊吓人。
Act10-1#11.t: I've heard you say that a good many times. You just keep using it to frighten people.

Act10-1#12.zh: 杨提辖且住！我在太师府里做奶公时，门下官军都向我喏喏连声。量你是个遭死的军人，相公抬举你做个提辖，便只顾逞能，把他们打，是何看待！
Act10-1#12.t: Hold on, Major Yang! When I was a nursemaid's husband in the Grand Tutor's mansion, the officers at the gate all bowed and scraped to me. You're just a condemned soldier the Regent was kind enough to make a major, and you show off by beating them. What do you take them for!

Act10-1#13.zh: 都管，你须是城市里人，生长在相府里，那里知道途路上千难万难。
Act10-1#13.t: Steward, you're a city man raised in a minister's mansion. How would you know the thousand hardships of the road?

Act10-1#14.zh: 四川、两广也曾去来，不曾见你这般卖弄。
Act10-1#14.t: I've been to Sichuan and Guangdong and Guangxi, and never saw anyone put on airs like you.

Act10-1#15.t: These aren't peaceful times any more.

Act10-1#16.t: And how is the realm not at peace today?

Act10-1#17.zh: （只得忍气）且住！对面松林里有人窥望，俺去看个明白！
Act10-1#17.t: (Swallowing his anger) Wait! Someone's peering at us from the pine wood across the way. I'll go and see!

Act10-1#18.zh: 什么人？莫不是劫客的强人？
Act10-1#18.t: Who's there? Could they be highway robbers?

Act10-1#21.t: Are you men up to no good?

Act10-1#22.zh: 我等弟兄七人，是濠州人，贩枣子上东京去。当不过热，权在这林子里歇一歇，待晚凉了行。
Act10-1#22.t: We're seven brothers from Haozhou, taking dates to sell in the Eastern Capital. We couldn't bear the heat, so we're resting in this wood until the cool of evening.

Act10-1#23.zh: 原来如此，也是一般的客人。却才见你们窥望，惟恐是歹人，因此赶来看一看。
Act10-1#23.t: I see, just merchants like us. I saw you peering and feared you were bandits, so I came to look.

Act10-1#24.zh: 客官请几个枣子了去。咦，那边又有人上冈了！
Act10-1#24.t: Have a few dates, sir. Oh, someone else is coming up the ridge!

Act10-1#25.zh: 远远地一个汉子，挑着一副担桶，唱上冈子来。
Act10-1#25.t: In the distance a man came up the ridge carrying a pair of buckets on a pole, singing.

Act10-1#26.zh: 赤日炎炎似火烧，野田禾稻半枯焦。农夫心内如汤煮，公子王孙把扇摇。
Act10-1#26.t: The red sun burns like fire, the rice in the fields half-scorched. The farmer's heart is boiling, while young lords wave their fans.

Act10-1#27.t: Buy a bucket of white wine, gentlemen!

Act10-1#30.zh: 我们又热又渴，何不凑钱买些吃，也解暑气？
Act10-1#30.t: We're hot and thirsty. Why not pool our money and buy some to cool off?

Act10-1#31.zh: 你们不得洒家言语，胡乱便要买酒吃！多少好汉，被蒙汗药麻翻了！
Act10-1#31.t: Without my say-so you'd go buying wine? Plenty of good men have been knocked out with drugged wine!

Act10-1#32.zh: 早是我不卖与你吃，却说出这般没气力的话来！
Act10-1#32.t: Lucky I wasn't selling to you anyway, if you talk such feeble nonsense!

Act10-1#33.zh: 既是他们疑心，且卖一桶与我们吃。
Act10-1#33.t: Since they're suspicious, sell a bucket to us.

Act10-1#35.zh: 五贯便依你五贯，只饶我们一瓢吃。
Act10-1#35.t: Five strings it is, but throw in a ladleful for free.

Act10-1#36.t: No freebies. The price is fixed!

Act10-1#37.zh: 贩枣客先吃尽一桶，又讨饶酒。一个偷舀半瓢，挑酒汉子追去；另一个也来舀酒，被劈手夺瓢，倾回桶里。众军汉都在旁看着。
Act10-1#37.t: The date merchants drank a whole bucket, then begged for extra. One sneaked half a ladle and the wine seller chased him; another dipped in too, but had the ladle snatched away and poured back into the bucket. The soldiers watched it all.

Act10-1#39.zh: （这伙客人买了一桶吃了，另一桶也当面吃了半瓢，想是好的……）
Act10-1#39.t: (Those merchants drank a whole bucket, and half a ladle from the other bucket right in front of us. It must be fine...)

Act10-1#40.zh: 那贩枣子客人已买了一桶酒吃，胡乱教他们买了避暑气。冈子上端的没处讨水吃。
Act10-1#40.t: The date merchants have already drunk a bucket. Let them buy some to beat the heat. There's no water to be had on this ridge.

Act10-1#41.zh: 既然老都管说了，教这厮们买吃了便起身。
Act10-1#41.t: Since the steward says so, let these fellows drink and then we set off.

Act10-1#42.zh: 大哥，另外一桶也卖与我们，润一润喉罢！
Act10-1#42.t: Brother, sell us the other bucket too, just to wet our throats!

Act10-1#43.zh: 不卖不卖！我酒里面有蒙汗药！
Act10-1#43.t: Not selling, not selling! My wine's drugged!

Act10-1#44.zh: （打了他们半日，也只得容他们买碗吃了便走。）
Act10-1#44.t: (I've beaten them half the day. I'll have to let them buy a bowl and then go.)

Act10-1#45.zh: 大哥，方才言语冲撞，休与我们计较！这是五贯足钱，烦借客人的椰瓢一用。
Act10-1#45.t: Brother, sorry for those words just now, don't hold it against us! Here's five full strings. May we borrow the merchants' coconut ladle?

Act10-1#46.zh: 贩枣客劝转卖酒汉子，众人付钱借瓢。谢都管先吃，两个虞候、众军汉接连饮酒。杨志见众人无事，终究热渴难熬。
Act10-1#46.t: The date merchants talked the wine seller round; the men paid and borrowed the ladle. Steward Xie drank first, then the two guards and the soldiers one after another. Seeing nothing happen to them, Yang Zhi could bear the heat and thirst no longer.

Act10-1#47.zh: 老都管和两位虞候都吃了，提辖也吃半瓢润润喉罢。
Act10-1#47.t: The old steward and both guards have drunk. Major, have half a ladle to wet your throat.

Act10-1#48.t: (Just half a ladle, then I'll get them moving.)

Act10-1#51.t: Oh no! The wine was drugged...

Act10-1#52.zh: 话未说完，杨志也眼前一黑，昏倒在地。军汉、虞候与老都管早已倒了一地。
Act10-1#52.t: Before he could finish, everything went dark and Yang Zhi collapsed. The soldiers, guards and old steward already lay all over the ground.

Act10-1#53.zh: 快把金珠装上车，咱们下冈去！
Act10-1#53.t: Quick, load the gold and jewels onto the carts. We're going down the ridge!

Act10-1#54.zh: 晁盖等人将十一担生辰纲装上车，推车下冈。
Act10-1#54.t: Chao Gai and the others loaded the eleven loads of birthday gifts onto carts and pushed them down the ridge.

Act10-1#55.t: Yellow Mud Ridge: the birthday gifts are stolen.
